scope: Registered reusable guide and pre-boss recipe, ItemIO save/load and clone. Six stages by four classes, three realm values and three engine calculation modes; actual damage-class identity, registered recipe quantities and conditions, resolved station names without graphical map tables, localized output and read-only inventory/cultivation/health/projectile state. World-stage selection covers all combinations of relevant flags.
limitations: Direct read-only guide calls, not physical left/right click or client chat rendering. No live client transport, real crafting, complete acquisition chain, localization layout or full playthrough. Class selection is transient; candidate suggestions do not assert use readiness or balance. Existing ledger icon is reused.
